<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png</span></p>

<div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This is an early mechanics guide on 2000% Amascut. Beware of mistakes, and expect an update in the near future. Numbers may vary based on team size! If you have suggestions for our guides, post them </nowiki>[https://discord.com/channels/534508796639182860/1020853673317908500 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Amascut the Devourer is an endgame group boss encounter, available after completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Eclipse_of_the_Heart <nowiki>Eclipse of the Heart</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest. Normal mode and 100%, 500%, 750%, 1000%, and 2000% enrage modes are available. Amascut drops the T95 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> halberd </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_Light <nowiki>Tumeken's Light</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the T95 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span> [https://runescape.wiki/w/Devourer%27s_Guard <nowiki>Devourer's Guard</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the T95 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> robes of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Tumeken%27s_resplendence_equipment <nowiki>Tumeken's Resplendence</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Devourer%27s_Nexus <nowiki>Devourer's Nexus</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence <nowiki>Shard of Genesis Essence</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="amascut-2000-stats" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Amascut 2000% stats</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ 12M </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="constitution">[[File:Constitution-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>constitution</nowiki>|<nowiki>constitution</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Size: 3x3</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ 95 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="defence">[[File:Defence.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>defence</nowiki>|<nowiki>defence</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 2765 armour rating</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ 55 affinity all</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="poisonicon">https://files.catbox.moe/x89b01.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> immune</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: Most mobs are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="poisonicon">https://files.catbox.moe/x89b01.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> immune!</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ No slayer creature</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Auto-attacks:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Left hand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack to all players.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Right hand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> AoE attack on tank that ricochets as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attacks on the other players. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> ricochet has a 10-tile range.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Three rapid </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> swipes on the tank. The style depends on her last auto-attack: For example: if it was </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, the three hits will be </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The following autos are based on your protection or deflect prayer on the first swipe hit. If you prayed wrong against it, the following auto-attacks will be the same type as the swipe hit.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After three autos, Amascut starts a new mechanic at 100% adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Mobs:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Gatekeeper Gorilla Akhs (150k LP). Need to be killed to use the gateways. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bindicon">[[File:Bound (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Feline Guard Akhs (25k LP). Will target those carrying a fragment of Tumeken. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bindicon">[[File:Bound (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Volatile Scarab Akhs (2k LP).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They need to be stunned </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> to take damage, and will explode if left alone.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Their spawn can be prevented by standing within one tile of their burrowing spots.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this successfully resets mobility cooldowns.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Modest Crocodile Demons (50k LP).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When its adrenaline bar is full, does </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack removing 20% adrenaline and applying a -50% adrenaline gain debuff on the target.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have Modesty buff.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Chainwarden Mage Akhs (130k LP). Protects the chains (50k LP each) beyond the gateways.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Explosive Scarabs (5k LP). Can be killed and then thrown to remove Carapace. Expire over time when killed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Lightstealer Salawa Akh (50k LP). Will target Tumeken's light bearers and drain charge or explode. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bindicon">[[File:Bound (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Devoured Mage and Ranger (15k LP). Stand on the platforms, barring you from Tumeken's Light.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Shadow of Amascut (150k LP). Deal </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bindicon">[[File:Bound (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>|<nowiki>bindicon</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. Can reduce </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> timer.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="buffs-and-debuffs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Buffs and Debuffs</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Lone Soul</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadowlink">[[File:Shadow Link.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Heal Other </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healother">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healother</nowiki>|<nowiki>healother</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, Heal Group </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healgroup">[[File:Heal Group icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404462300722626642.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healgroup</nowiki>|<nowiki>healgroup</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, and Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are disabled at 2000% and above.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Corruption</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruption">[[File:Corruption (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The base gains one stack of Corruption </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruption">[[File:Corruption (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for every auto-attack received, increasing damage taken. Getting hit by Soulfire waves and Shockwaves also gives </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruption">[[File:Corruption (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stacks. Max 15 stacks, and stacks expire ~15s after the last one has been given.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In phase 7 every player gets </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruption">[[File:Corruption (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stacks from Amascut's auto-attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="apmekensburden">[[File:Apmeken's Burden.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>|<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Is applied by Amascut early in phase 2. Deals damage every 1.8s and adds a stack. Can be transferred to teammates. Damage increases every hit, instakilling the player at 8 stacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage can be halved by </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (not by </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut will apply this debuff in phase 7 when Apmeken is invoked.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Modesty</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="modesty">[[File:Modesty.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>|<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Reflects non-basic attacks such as threshold and ultimate abilities, adren-costing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> abilities, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> , </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="volleyofsouls">[[File:Volley of Souls.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>volleyofsouls</nowiki>|<nowiki>volleyofsouls</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> , plus extra hits from </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bolg">[[File:Bow of the Last Guardian.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>|<nowiki>bolg</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="fsoa">[[File:Fractured Staff of Armadyl.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>fsoa</nowiki>|<nowiki>fsoa</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Does </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> reflect basic abilities, auto-attacks, conjure damage, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="as4">[[File:Aftershock.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>as4</nowiki>|<nowiki>as4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> , </nowiki><span title="crack4">[[File:Crackling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>|<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> , and </nowiki><span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Healing in Strength</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healinginstrength">[[File:Healing in Strength.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>|<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where any damage they deal heals Amascut for ~30%.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Het is invoked.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Carapace</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="carapace">[[File:Carapace (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>|<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Multiple mobs can have this effect during Phase 4, where they are immune to damage until an explosive scarab is thrown at them.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Amascut gains this effect in phase 7 when Scabaras is invoked. Requires 3 Scarabs to break.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Interceptor</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Gained upon blocking Amascut's Altar strike once in phase 5. Taking another strike will be an instakill </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Gained after Jumping and taken Tumeken's Light in phase 6. Appears as a 5x5 light area around you.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any green bar blasts exploding in the area are nulled.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Shadow Tear</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="comb">[[File:Combust.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>comb</nowiki>|<nowiki>comb</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Debuff from absorbing Engulfed Shadow Tears in phase 6. Explode after a short period of time, Dealing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage for each tear absorbed. Says it pierces through shielding, but </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> blocks it fully.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as combust.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Shadow Link</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadowlink">[[File:Shadow Link.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Shadows of Amascut have a buff when within 15 squares of each other called Shadow Link. This increases their attack speed and damage dealt per stack, and they can hit through </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Inner Darkness</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadowlink">[[File:Shadow Link.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will take reduced damage from all sources that do not have the Light Within buff in phase 7.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Shadow Link.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Light Within</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Granted to all players when successfully passing Tumeken's Strike to the called altar in phase 7, ricocheting it back to Amascut. Allows them to deal full damage to Amascut for 30s.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Same icon as Interceptor.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
